title: 建议信
goal: 能针对具体困难提出建议并说明理由。

points.label: 选择针对具体困难的建议
为建议补入对应的理由

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 建议信的结构、表达和知识点

cards.title: 结构
rows: 回应困难
指出对方遇到的具体问题。
I understand that you have trouble finding time to read.
提出建议
提出可执行的行动。
You could read for fifteen minutes after lunch.
说明理由
解释行动与困难的联系。
This period is available even on busy days.
预期帮助
说明行动可能产生的帮助。
A regular reading time may help you finish more books.

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: could
You could make a weekly plan.
could 后接动词原形。
suggest doing
I suggest keeping a reading log.
suggest 后接动名词。
it would help to
It would help to label each folder.
to 后接动词原形。
说明理由
This makes the notes easier to find.
说明建议如何回应困难。
预期帮助
This may help you remember the dates.
may 表示可能的帮助。

body.box:
假定李华的同学常忘记作业截止日期，需要给他提出一条建议并说明理由。
• Suggest a concrete action.
• Explain how it helps.
Draft: You could write each deadline in a calendar. Checking it every evening will help you see which task is due next.

body.p: 建议是在日历上记下截止日期。理由是每晚查看日历，可以看到下一项要交的任务。两句都针对忘记截止日期这一困难。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 建议空泛
You should do better.
You could write each deadline in a calendar.
指责读者
You are careless and never plan.
You could review your calendar each evening.
建议偏离困难
Buy a new notebook for drawing.
Keep a list of deadlines in your notebook.
理由不对应
A calendar comes in many colors.
A calendar shows which task is due next.

groups.text: 假定同学在准备演讲时经常忘记要点。

options: You could write key words on a small card.
You could try harder to remember everything.
You could look at the audience more often.
You could write the date of the speech down.
items.why: 困难是演讲时忘记要点。第一项把关键词写在卡片上，演讲时看卡片就能想起要点。

groups.text: 假定同学寻找课堂笔记时需要花很长时间，建议是给文件夹标注科目。

options: Finding the notes takes a long time.
The labels make each subject easier to find.
The subjects are taught by several teachers.
The folders are available in different colors.
items.why: 困难是找笔记慢。第二项说明标签让各科笔记更好找，把建议和困难联系起来。第一项只重复了困难。

groups.text: 假定同学不熟悉图书馆借书规则。

options: You could borrow more books from the library each week.
You should have learned the rules already.
You could ask a librarian about borrowing rules.
You could return your library books on time.
items.why: 困难是不熟悉借书规则。第三项请对方向图书管理员询问规则，直接解决这一困难。第二项是指责，不是建议。

groups.text: 假定同学常忘记带参加远足的物品，建议出发前核对清单。

options: Items are often forgotten before a hike.
A list can be written on colored paper.
The items may be kept in different rooms.
A list shows which items are still missing.
items.why: 困难是忘带物品。第四项说明清单能显示还缺哪些物品，出发前核对就不会遗漏。

items.stem: Suggest a practical way to remember meeting dates.
items.why: could 后接 write，记录日期对应记忆困难。

items.stem: Explain how a labeled folder helps locate notes.
items.why: makes the notes easier to find 说明标注对寻找笔记的帮助。

groups.text: 假定同学准备考试时找不到复习资料。

items.stem: Which suggestion directly addresses the difficulty?
options: You could sort your notes by subject.
You could study harder for the exam.
You could mark the exam date in a calendar.
You could borrow more revision books.
items.why: 困难是找不到复习资料。第一项按科目整理笔记，需要时就能找到对应资料。

items.stem: Why would sorting the notes by subject help?
options: The exam covers many different subjects.
The relevant notes become easier to locate.
Sorted notes look neater and take up less space.
Some revision materials cannot be found.
items.why: 困难是找不到资料。第二项说明整理后各科笔记更容易找到，与困难对应。第三项只说整齐、省地方，与困难无关。

groups.text: 假定同学在英语社团讨论时听不清发言者，社团允许调换座位。

options: You could speak louder yourself when it is your turn.
You could write a summary after each discussion.
You could sit closer to the speaker in discussions.
You could move to a seat at the back of the room.
items.why: 困难是听不清发言者，社团允许换座位。第三项建议坐近一些，正好针对听不清。第一项是让自己大声说，弄错了说话的人。

items.stem: Which reason supports sitting nearer to the speaker?
options: The speaker may then talk more loudly.
Seats near the speaker are more comfortable.
The discussion may cover several topics.
The speaker's words may be easier to hear.
items.why: 困难是听不清。第四项说明坐近后更容易听清发言，理由与困难对应。第一项把变化放在了发言者身上。

items.stem: Suggest a way to remember library due dates.
items.why: could 后接 write，在日历上记录日期回应遗忘的问题。

items.stem: Explain how a calendar helps with due dates.
items.why: helps you see 说明日历如何提示到期的书。

items.stem: Suggest a way to organize subject notes.
items.why: suggest 后接 keeping，分类存放对应整理笔记的需求。

items.stem: Explain how notes in separate folders help a student.
items.why: makes the notes easier to find 表达分类后的预期帮助。
